Primary subject:

A sharp dark iron vertical coulter hangs from the beam immediately IN FRONT of the triangular horizontal ploughshare; directly behind that share a coherent curved iron-faced MOULDBOARD turns outward to lift a furrow. Clearly show the three distinct connected cutting parts, not a random pile of iron. Weathered brown oak, neutral charcoal iron with restrained worn edge highlights. This is a simplified eighteenth-century concept, not an exact museum replica or universally applicable national model.
